title: Moose Hill Ranch Equestrian Centre

services.name: Horse Trainer
services.desc: Calgary is a big, expansive city with plenty going on in the urban setting. A rural setting in necessary for boarding a horse and we are only 20 minutes from Calgary. Moose Hill Ranch is in a perfect location, so close to the city. We are easy to get to and are local to other residents in neighboring areas, including Bragg Creek, Cochrane, and Priddis, Millarville etc. Our close distance from the city still allows us to offer over 400 acres of room for your horses to run, train, and roam. We provide many boarding options so that you have a range of choices that fit your horse's needs and fit your budget and price point. blurb: Moose Hill Ranch is a new, first-class equestrian and boarding stable owned by Mary Robinson, Jessie Young, Logan, Courtney, Luke & Hudson Young. This ranch has been in the family since 1888 and is still an active horse & cattle ranch. Our love for horses was the incentive for building this facility and to offer a multitude of riding opportunities for the clients. It has 400 acres for the boarders to enjoy riding.
